info.name: Asyntai AI Chatbot
info.summary: An AI assistant that answers questions on every Nextcloud page
info.description:
Adds the Asyntai AI assistant to your Nextcloud.
A small chat button sits in the corner of every page. Users click it and ask a question in their own words. The assistant answers from your own content: your help pages, your handbook, your policies, your website. It replies in more than 80 languages.
Typical use: an internal help desk that never sleeps. "How do I share a folder with someone outside the company?" "Where is the travel policy?" "Who do I ask for a new laptop?" The assistant answers, so your team does not have to.
**What the app does**
The app adds one small loader script to the page. The script waits for the page to finish drawing, then loads the assistant. Nextcloud is drawn first, so page speed does not change.
**What the administrator controls**
* The Asyntai widget ID. Leave it empty and the assistant is switched off. * Whether logged in users see the assistant. * Whether visitors on public share pages and the login page see it. * An optional script address, for a self hosted widget.
**Where the data goes**
Nextcloud never talks to Asyntai. Only the browser does, and only after the page has loaded. No file, no user name and no Nextcloud data is sent by the app.
You need an Asyntai account for the widget ID. There is a free plan.
